definitions.gloss: detailed examination; thorough checkup; comprehensive testing
definitions.explanation: A thorough medical examination or inspection that goes beyond routine screening, typically ordered when an abnormality is suspected.

examples.japanese: {精密検査|せいみつけんさ}を{受|う}ける。
{健康診断|けんこうしんだん}で{異常|いじょう}が{見|み}つかり、{精密検査|せいみつけんさ}を{勧|すす}められた。
examples.english: An abnormality was found during my health checkup, and I was advised to get a detailed examination.

examples.japanese: {精密検査|せいみつけんさ}の{結果|けっか}、{特|とく}に{問題|もんだい}はないとのことで{安心|あんしん}した。
examples.english: I was relieved when the detailed examination results showed no particular problems.

notes:
Composed of {精密|せいみつ} (precise, detailed) + {検査|けんさ} (examination, inspection). Refers to a more thorough level of testing than a routine screening or checkup.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {精密検査|せいみつけんさ}を{受|う}ける (to undergo a detailed examination)
- {精密検査|せいみつけんさ}の{結果|けっか} (results of the detailed examination)
- {精密検査|せいみつけんさ}を{勧|すす}められる (to be advised to get a detailed exam)
- {精密検査|せいみつけんさ}が{必要|ひつよう} (a detailed examination is needed)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {健康診断|けんこうしんだん} — health checkup; the routine annual screening that may lead to {精密検査|せいみつけんさ}
- {検査|けんさ} — examination, inspection; the general term
- {人間|にんげん}ドック — comprehensive health screening; a voluntary, thorough checkup (from "human dock")

USAGE:
In Japan's healthcare system, annual {健康診断|けんこうしんだん} (health checkups) are standard for employees and residents. If something abnormal is found, the next step is a {精密検査|せいみつけんさ} — a follow-up with specialized testing such as MRI, CT scans, or endoscopy.
